data: Which of the following features has the worst performance?

The question asks which feature has the worst performance. From the caption, we know that the performance is measured in terms of Mean Absolute Error (MAE). The lines in the graph represent different feature sets: W Feats, TFeats, Rules, and Combinations. 

Looking at the graph, the line representing W Feats (green) consistently shows the highest MAE across all window lengths. This indicates that W Feats has the worst performance among the four feature sets. Therefore, the answer is W Feats.
